The passenger air bag disabled warning light comes on upon start-up and stays lit for longer than 4 seconds. (carry out the initial control unit test)

If the manual switch is turned to OFF, the warning light should stay on

When the manual switch key is turned to ON, the warning light flashes for 4 seconds and then goes out.

When the ignition is in ON position, the warning light flashes for 4 seconds to indicate seat status has changed from "vacant" to "occupied".
